title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 159
paragraphs: Hearing this, Syagrus could not contain himself and said: “Deeply, I believe, would Agamemnon son of Pelops groan, if he heard that the Spartans had had the leadership taken from them by Gelon and the Syracusans. No — make no further mention of the condition that we should hand the leadership over to you. If you wish to come to Greece's aid, know that you will be under the command of the Lacedaemonians; and if you insist on not being under command, do not come to our help at all.”
